about: Kemerovo: A. A. Leonov International Airport, 5 km south-east of the city outskirts and 11 km from the centre. One runway; the airfield operates round the clock and is shared with the Ministry of Defence and Rosgvardia.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: Domestic business lounge on Level 3, to the right after security, open from 04:30 to 20:00. Free for business class passengers and holders of cards with access rights; economy passengers via Every Lounge, GoldenKey, RusPriority, Persona.aero and other programmes. Paid entry 4,000 ₽, children 2–12 years 2,000 ₽, under 2 free.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Left luggage follows the domestic terminal schedule. Hand luggage 200 ₽ per day, baggage up to 50×40×20 cm 220 ₽, larger 270 ₽, over 100×50×70 cm 500 ₽. Less than a day is charged as a full day.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: Mother and child room on Level 3, in the left wing next to the security area, free, from 04:30 to 20:00. For departing passengers with children under 7, disabled children under 14 and women in the second half of pregnancy.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: Station forecourt 30 m from the terminal, 173 spaces: up to 15 minutes free, first hour 300 ₽, second and third 200 ₽ each, from the fourth hour the daily rate of 1,000 ₽.
